learning_outcomes.text: Acquire a solid global knowledge of vision systems applied to robotics or quality/non-destructive control and of the engineering profession in these domains.
Students will be able to analyze, design, and implement industrial vision solutions tailored to specific needs.

syllabus_topics: Definition and utility of industrial vision systems
Industrial applications: quality control, robotics, satellite imaging
Interdisciplinary cooperation for high-performance real-time processing
Practical sessions: Image processing application development using Matlab
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*TP1)/1, indicating that the practical work (TP1) constitutes 100% of the grade.
